decisions.reason: The exact-output swap and ETH refund decision applies only to wallet-based ETH payments; the deferred Transak fiat-to-USDC flow remains unchanged.
The decision changes how ETH is swapped and refunded but preserves the $15 mint price and does not alter revenue allocation.
The decision concerns the ETH-to-USDC swap path and does not change direct USDC wallet minting or its approval-to-mint behavior.
ETH minting remains required; only the separately modeled swap-input and excess-refund mechanism changes.
Changing the ETH swap method and refund asset does not alter when mint-success feedback may be displayed.
The decision changes ETH payment execution but does not add, remove, disable, or relabel any presented payment method.
Automatic wallet provisioning for Transak fiat buyers is independent of the connected-wallet ETH swap and refund mechanism.
The source decision does not mention or logically change tip availability, preset amounts, custom tips, or tipping placement.
The FAQ's $15 mint-price statement remains valid, and the source does not require public copy about the exact-output swap or ETH refund behavior.
The ETH swap implementation decision does not alter the hero copy, CTA, layout, or visual emphasis.
Using exact-output ETH swaps and refunding unspent ETH does not change the unlimited-mint NFT ebook collection model.
The source decision changes ETH payment handling only and does not resolve or modify allocation of commissions for mints without referral codes.
